criteria.no: The item does not give the writer thread the sole writable connection: it is silent, only names the topic, or puts writable connections elsewhere.
criteria.unclear: The item mentions writer-thread ownership of a connection but it is not possible to tell whether that connection is the only writable one.
criteria.yes: The item gives the writer thread the sole writable SQLite connection or handle.

addressed.instructions: Does `item.text` plan for the directive in `anchor.statement`: the SQLite writer thread owns the app's only write connection? Accept any wording that gives a dedicated writer thread the sole writable connection or handle (sole, only, single, all writes sent to it, other connections read-only). Judge presence of the directive only, not whether the item conflicts with it.

criteria.no: Nothing other than the writer thread is given a read-write SQLite connection, or the item does not say.
criteria.unclear: An extra SQLite connection is described but whether it can write is not stated.
criteria.yes: Something other than the writer thread is given a read-write SQLite connection.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` let anything other than the SQLite writer thread write to SQLite through its own read-write connection? Judge conflict only. Silence is not conflict; read-only connections elsewhere are not conflict; other databases are not covered; a stated exception is still a conflict.

criteria.no: The item works on something other than SQLite storage.
criteria.unclear: It cannot be determined whether the item touches SQLite storage.
criteria.yes: The item works on SQLite storage, the SQLite writer, or SQLite connections.

relevant.instructions: Does `item.text` plan or change SQLite storage code (a SQLite store, the SQLite writer, or SQLite connections)? Only SQLite counts; other databases do not. Judge subject matter only.
